title: Flush orders-cache entries written under the old schema
description: Per the runbook, flush the affected order keys. Confirm first that the flush will not cause a load spike.

title: Follow the cache runbook diagnostics
description: Check the hit ratio and compare key counts with yesterday.

title: Queue runbook
description: Purge the dead-letter queue and requeue the failed jobs.

title: Verify invoice email delivery and provider status
description: Read the retry warnings and the provider's status page.

title: Verify auth-service is listening and restore it or fail over
description: Check the listener, then restore service.

title: Confirm pool saturation on the database
description: Query pg_stat_activity and compare with the pool size.

title: Review what changed in the last release
description: Read the diff of the linked pull request.

title: Grant the on-call engineer access
description: Add them to the admin group.

title: Investigate the retry failures before any remediation
description: Read the full WARN lines, then determine whether the release is responsible.

title: Investigate invoice email retry failures before any remediation
description: Read the full retry WARN lines and the provider's error logs, then decide whether v2.0.0 is responsible. No change should be made until that is done.

title: Review what changed between the two releases
description: List the configuration changes and compare them.

title: Lower DB_POOL_MAX
description: Update the value in the deployment manifest.
